title: Abstract Glass and Metal on Red
coreRelationships: Sharp, reflective glass in the foreground contrasts with a soft, blurred metallic object in the background.
Vibrant red background serves as a strong, uniform color field against the cooler tones of the objects.
Strong highlights on the glass and metallic surfaces create a sense of depth and material quality.
The diagonal orientation of the glass object's edges creates dynamic lines across the frame.
The interplay of light and shadow on the glass reveals its three-dimensional form and transparency.
reuseFormula: Focus on a clear, reflective glass object (e.g., a bottle) in a close-up, diagonal composition. Place a blurred, luminous metallic object behind it. Use a solid, vibrant red background. Emphasize strong highlights and reflections on the glass to define its form and material. Maintain a shallow depth of field to separate foreground and background.
